description: xgcm is the xgcm community's Python package for analysing output from general circulation models and related finite-volume datasets. It understands staggered grid positions such as cell centres and faces and supplies interpolation, difference, differential and integral operators. Inputs are xarray datasets with grid definitions; outputs are transformed or derived labelled arrays. Geographic coverage and resolution follow the ocean or atmospheric model grid. Source is free under MIT, with examples and public documentation. A limitation is that users must correctly describe the grid and variable locations; treating staggered fields as collocated can produce incorrect calculations. xgcm can prepare model-derived environmental fields or compare simulation outputs used in coastal and climate infrastructure studies. Iris (platform-scitools-iris) is related Earth-science analysis software. The project is part of the Pangeo initiative. No circulation-model output or package archive was downloaded.
